_comment: Hand triage of known findings (scenario id + finding kind + key). Causes: likely-engine-bug | kb-gap | likely-wrong-expectation | harness-issue. Unlisted findings get a default by kind/confidence in runKgScenarios.ts.

entries.note: DOC_CONSULTA_UBICACION has no depends_on edge, so the consulta renders after the construction permit it gates (expert to confirm the sequence).
Patente (needs-more-info, 'conditional' group) renders above the Permiso Unico it depends on ('prerequisites' group): group order beats the KB edge.
Off-lot water pin: layers.ts withholds zoning but keeps flood/coastal facts, so RULE_0706 makes Reg. 13 REQUIRED for a pin in the harbor (policy call for the expert: ask to move the pin instead).
RULE_0708 fires on any renovation in the coastal zone, including interior-only work with exterior_work=false (rule itself is marked EXPERT VALIDATION NEEDED).
PR_FLOODPLAIN_REG13 is REQUIRED for rooftop PV on an existing warehouse in AE; whether rooftop equipment is 'development' under Reg. 13 is an expert call.
RULE_0709 fires for a farm barn on SREP agricultural land; whether an agricultural accessory structure for a bona fide farmer needs a consulta is an expert call.
